title: P0300 — Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
subtitle: Common causes, symptoms, and what to check first.

blocks.text: Code P0300 means the engine computer detected misfires happening across more than one cylinder, or the pattern isn't isolated to a single cylinder.

items: Fuel smell or poor fuel economy
Low compression or internal engine damage
Scan for additional codes like P0301–P0308
Check live misfire counters using a scan tool
Inspect spark plugs and ignition coils
Test fuel pressure and injector operation
Smoke test the intake system for vacuum leaks

blocks.text: Quick Things You Can Check First

items: Check the condition of spark plugs
Clean the MAF sensor if dirty

blocks.text: If the check engine light is flashing, reduce load and avoid hard driving. Misfires can overheat and damage the catalytic converter.

disclaimer: Educational only. Diagnostics vary by vehicle; confirm with a qualified technician.
